technical_anchor.query: SELECT VALUE FROM V$PARAMETER WHERE NAME = 'db_securefile'

metrics.description: Whether hidden (underscore) initialization parameters are absent, or each one is documented with a My Oracle Support justification. Undocumented hidden parameters can cause corruption and leave the database unsupported.
metrics.remediation: Remove unjustified underscore parameters; document any required ones with the MOS reference.

technical_anchor.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM V$PARAMETER WHERE NAME LIKE '\_%' ESCAPE '\' AND ISDEFAULT='FALSE'

metrics.description: Whether an AutoUpgrade analyze run for the next LTS completes without unresolved ERROR findings, proving the database is upgrade-ready.
metrics.remediation: Run autoupgrade.jar -mode analyze for the target release and clear ERROR-level findings.

metrics.description: Whether the instance configuration (spfile/pfile, password file, network files) is backed up so the instance can be rebuilt after host loss.
metrics.remediation: Back up spfile (RMAN/controlfile autobackup covers spfile), the password file, and listener/tnsnames/sqlnet.

consistency_rules.title: Encrypted tablespaces present but keystore is not open
consistency_rules.description: TDE is in active use, yet the wallet/keystore is not open — encrypted data becomes unreadable at the next restart and TDE operations fail now.

on_violation.title: Encrypted data becomes unreadable at next restart
on_violation.description: Keystore state is {value:wallet_status} while encrypted tablespaces exist. Queries on encrypted data fail until the keystore opens.
on_violation.remediation: Configure an auto-login (local) keystore or open it; verify WALLET_ROOT / sqlnet.ora configuration.

consistency_rules.title: FRA nearly full on an ARCHIVELOG database
consistency_rules.description: When the Fast Recovery Area fills, archiving stops and the database suspends. The 80% metric threshold is a warning; beyond 90% a hang is imminent.

on_violation.title: FRA at {value:fra_usage_pct}% — archiver hang imminent
on_violation.description: Reclaimable space may mask urgency; act on the trend, not the average.
on_violation.remediation: Raise DB_RECOVERY_FILE_DEST_SIZE, back up and delete archivelogs, or relocate the FRA.

consistency_rules.title: RMAN schedule declared but last backup is stale
consistency_rules.description: A declared schedule with a stale last successful backup means the backup job is failing or disabled — the silent-failure pattern.

on_violation.title: Declared backup schedule is not being honored
on_violation.description: Schedule says {value:rman_backup_schedule} but the last successful backup is {value:last_rman_backup_age}h old.
on_violation.remediation: Check the scheduler job, RMAN logs, and V$RMAN_BACKUP_JOB_DETAILS.

consistency_rules.title: Data Guard configured but FORCE LOGGING is off
consistency_rules.description: Without FORCE LOGGING, any direct-path/NOLOGGING write creates unrecoverable blocks on the standby — discovered only at failover.

on_violation.title: Standby can silently diverge: NOLOGGING operations are not shipped
on_violation.description: The DR guarantee is void for any object written with NOLOGGING since the standby was created.
on_violation.remediation: ALTER DATABASE FORCE LOGGING; validate the standby with RMAN VALIDATE or DBVERIFY.

consistency_rules.title: Apply lag inconsistent with the declared protection mode
consistency_rules.description: MAXIMUM AVAILABILITY/PROTECTION promise near-zero loss via synchronous transport; a standby minutes behind means the promise is not being kept.

on_violation.title: Protection mode promises near-zero loss; standby is {value:dataguard_apply_lag}s behind
on_violation.description: Transport is degraded or apply is stalled relative to the declared mode.
on_violation.remediation: Check MRP0 state, network throughput, and standby redo logs; review V$DATAGUARD_STATS.

consistency_rules.title: Short undo retention with a nearly full undo tablespace
consistency_rules.description: Low retention and no room to keep undo combine into ORA-01555 exactly under load — long queries fail when the system is busiest.

on_violation.title: ORA-01555 conditions: retention {value:undo_retention}s with undo at {value:undo_usage_pct}%
on_violation.description: Undo cannot honor even the short declared retention once the tablespace is saturated.
on_violation.remediation: Grow the undo tablespace (autoextend) and raise UNDO_RETENTION toward the longest query horizon.

consistency_rules.title: Neither PGA target nor SGA auto-management configured
consistency_rules.description: Every pool hand-sized and no PGA ceiling: workload drift ends in ORA-04031/ORA-04030 instead of a graceful resize.

on_violation.title: Fully manual memory with no aggregate bounds
on_violation.description: Neither automatic rebalancing nor an aggregate PGA limit protects this instance from workload drift.
on_violation.remediation: Set SGA_TARGET and PGA_AGGREGATE_TARGET (plus PGA_AGGREGATE_LIMIT).

consistency_rules.title: Incremental backup schedule without Block Change Tracking
consistency_rules.description: Without BCT, every level-1 incremental scans the full database — the backup window grows with size, not with change rate.

on_violation.title: Level-1 incrementals scan every datafile block
on_violation.description: Enabling BCT reduces incremental backup I/O to the changed-block set.
on_violation.remediation: ALTER DATABASE ENABLE BLOCK CHANGE TRACKING USING FILE '...' (EE feature).

consistency_rules.title: Session saturation amplifying row-lock contention
consistency_rules.description: Near-exhausted session slots combined with sustained row-lock waits indicate a saturation spiral: new sessions queue on locks held by sessions that cannot finish.

on_violation.title: Sessions at {value:session_utilization_pct}% with {value:row_lock_contention} row-lock waits
on_violation.description: session_utilization_pct={value:session_utilization_pct} and row_lock_contention={value:row_lock_contention}; both capacity and performance are degraded by the same saturation event.
on_violation.remediation: Investigate blocking sessions (V$SESSION/V$LOCK), add connection pooling or raise sessions/processes judiciously, and resolve the lead blocker.

consistency_rules.title: Encrypted tablespaces present but the keystore is not backed up
consistency_rules.description: TDE is in use yet there is no separate keystore backup — losing the keystore makes every encrypted backup unrecoverable.

on_violation.title: Keystore loss would make encrypted backups unrecoverable
on_violation.description: Encrypted tablespaces exist but no separate keystore backup is recorded. RMAN does not back up the keystore.
on_violation.remediation: Back up the TDE keystore to a location separate from the database backups and verify restore.

consistency_rules.title: Large instance memory without HugePages
consistency_rules.description: A large SGA/PGA footprint is configured but HugePages are not enabled, wasting memory on page tables and risking ASMM/AMM instability.

on_violation.title: Large SGA/PGA without HugePages
on_violation.description: Instance memory is {value:oracle_memory_pct_of_ram}% of RAM but use_large_pages is off.
on_violation.remediation: Configure Linux HugePages to cover the SGA and set USE_LARGE_PAGES=ONLY (or TRUE).

consistency_rules.title: PDB count near MAX_PDBS without a resource plan
consistency_rules.description: The CDB is approaching MAX_PDBS while no CDB resource plan isolates PDB resources — consolidation pressure with no guardrails.

on_violation.title: High PDB density without resource isolation
on_violation.description: PDB count is {value:pdb_count_vs_max}% of MAX_PDBS and no CDB resource plan is active.
on_violation.remediation: Create a CDB resource plan to isolate PDB CPU/parallelism, and plan capacity before the cap.

consistency_rules.title: SYSAUX growing with no audit purge job
consistency_rules.description: SYSAUX is past its warn band while no audit-trail purge job runs — AUDSYS/AWR occupants will keep filling SYSAUX.

on_violation.title: SYSAUX filling without an audit purge job
on_violation.description: SYSAUX is at {value:sysaux_growth}% and no audit-trail purge job is scheduled.
on_violation.remediation: Schedule DBMS_AUDIT_MGMT purge, tune AWR retention, and resize SYSAUX as needed.

consistency_rules.title: Aggressive RTO declared without Data Guard
consistency_rules.description: A minutes-level RTO (rto_5/rto_15) is not achievable by RMAN restore alone; Oracle MAA requires a standby. Without Data Guard, the declared RTO has no basis.

on_violation.title: Declared RTO {value:rto_target} is unachievable — no Data Guard standby
on_violation.description: rto_target={value:rto_target} claims minutes-level recovery, but dataguard_configured is not attested; RMAN restore alone cannot meet this RTO.
on_violation.remediation: Configure a Data Guard standby for fast failover, or relax rto_target to a horizon RMAN restore can meet.

consistency_rules.title: Aggressive RTO declared without tested recovery
consistency_rules.description: An RTO of one hour or less cannot be trusted unless recovery has actually been tested.

on_violation.title: Declared RTO {value:rto_target} is unproven — recovery not tested
on_violation.description: rto_target={value:rto_target} but recovery_tested is not attested; the RTO declaration earns no points until recovery is validated.
on_violation.remediation: Perform and document a recovery test at the declared RTO, or relax rto_target.

consistency_rules.title: Recovery attested as tested but backups are stale
consistency_rules.description: A tested-recovery claim is not credible when the most recent RMAN backup is over a week old.

on_violation.title: Recovery marked tested but last RMAN backup is {value:last_rman_backup_age}h old
on_violation.description: recovery_tested is attested but last_rman_backup_age={value:last_rman_backup_age} hours; a recovery test against week-old backups does not reflect current recoverability.
on_violation.remediation: Restore RMAN backup currency, then re-run and document the recovery test.

consistency_rules.title: Tablespace encryption attested but no encrypted tablespaces observed
consistency_rules.description: A tablespace-encryption attestation is contradicted when zero encrypted tablespaces are present.

on_violation.title: Tablespace encryption attested but none observed
on_violation.description: tablespace_encryption is attested but tde_encrypted_tablespaces={value:tde_encrypted_tablespaces}; the observation contradicts the attestation.
on_violation.remediation: Encrypt the tablespaces holding sensitive data, or correct the attestation.

consistency_rules.title: Regulated posture declared on Enterprise Edition without TDE
consistency_rules.description: A regulated posture on Enterprise Edition (where TDE is licensable) requires encrypted tablespaces. Finding zero encrypted tablespaces contradicts the declaration.

on_violation.title: Regulated posture declared but no tablespace is encrypted
on_violation.description: security_posture=regulated on Enterprise Edition but tde_encrypted_tablespaces={value:tde_encrypted_tablespaces}; a regulated posture must encrypt data at rest.
on_violation.remediation: Enable TDE and encrypt sensitive tablespaces, or lower the declared security_posture. (Standard Edition estates are exempt — TDE is not licensable there.)

consistency_rules.title: Regulated posture declared without auditing
consistency_rules.description: A regulated posture expects an audit trail (unified auditing or an active audit policy). The absence of both contradicts the declaration.

on_violation.title: Regulated posture declared but no auditing is active
on_violation.description: security_posture=regulated but neither unified_auditing_enabled nor audit_policy_active is attested; a regulated database is expected to keep an audit trail.
on_violation.remediation: Enable unified auditing or an active audit policy, or lower the declared security_posture.

consistency_rules.title: Growth headroom declared while a tablespace is already critical
consistency_rules.description: A growth-headroom target implies spare space. With one or more tablespaces already past their usage threshold, the headroom claim does not hold.

on_violation.title: Growth headroom declared but {value:tablespace_usage} tablespace(s) already critical
on_violation.description: growth_headroom_target={value:growth_headroom_target} but tablespace_usage={value:tablespace_usage} tablespace(s) are over their usage threshold; there is no headroom to plan against.
on_violation.remediation: Extend or reorganise the critical tablespace(s) to restore headroom, or shorten the declared growth horizon.

consistency_rules.title: DR topology declared without Data Guard configured
consistency_rules.description: Any Data Guard or RAC+DG topology implies Data Guard is configured. Its absence contradicts the declaration.

on_violation.title: DR topology declared but Data Guard is not configured
on_violation.description: dr_topology={value:dr_topology} but dataguard_configured is not attested; no standby backs the declared DR topology.
on_violation.remediation: Configure Data Guard to match the declared topology, or declare dr_topology=none.

consistency_rules.title: Synchronous DR declared but protection mode is not synchronous
consistency_rules.description: A dg_sync topology requires MAXIMUM PROTECTION or MAXIMUM AVAILABILITY. MAXIMUM PERFORMANCE is asynchronous and contradicts the declaration.

on_violation.title: Synchronous DR declared but protection mode is {value:dataguard_protection_mode}
on_violation.description: dr_topology=dg_sync but dataguard_protection_mode={value:dataguard_protection_mode}; the declared synchronous DR is not actually in force.
on_violation.remediation: Set the Data Guard protection mode to MAXIMUM AVAILABILITY (or MAXIMUM PROTECTION), or declare dr_topology=dg_async.

consistency_rules.title: Upgrade plan declared while patching is over a year stale
consistency_rules.description: An upgrade plan that leaves the database unpatched for more than twelve months is not being executed.

on_violation.title: Upgrade plan declared but last patch is {value:latest_patch} months old
on_violation.description: upgrade_plan is attested but latest_patch={value:latest_patch} months; a plan that leaves the database this far behind on patches is not delivering.
on_violation.remediation: Apply the current Release Update, or revise the upgrade plan to reflect reality.

consistency_rules.title: RPO target unachievable with declared backup strategy
consistency_rules.description: rpo_5/rpo_15 require continuous archived-redo shipping (frequent archivelog backups or a Data Guard standby). Daily or no RMAN backups with no standby cannot bound sub-hour RPO.

on_violation.title: Declared RPO {value:rpo_target} unachievable with {value:rman_backup_schedule} backups and no standby
on_violation.description: rpo_target={value:rpo_target} but rman_backup_schedule={value:rman_backup_schedule} and no Data Guard standby is configured; sub-hour RPO needs frequent archivelog backups or real-time redo transport.
on_violation.remediation: Schedule frequent archivelog backups (level0_level1 or continuous), add a Data Guard standby, or relax rpo_target.
